channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Isaias becomes hurricane, heads toward Gulf Coast
item.description: The storm became the first Atlantic hurricane of the season on Thursday, the latest first hurricane on record.

item.title: Rubio criticizes press over Guilfoyle allegations question
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio responded sharply to reporters asking about allegations involving Kimberly Guilfoyle, the U.S. ambassador to Greece.

item.title: Curtis Flowers, wrongfully convicted death row inmate, dies at 56
item.description: One of Curtis Flowers' attorneys described his case as unprecedented in the history of the American legal system.

item.title: Attorney says Jane Doe faces threats, cites Cornell's alleged failures
item.description: The former Cornell student who reported an alleged gang rape at a campus fraternity has faced threats and doxxing attempts, her attorney said.
